Live track record shows an overall MAE of 6.8 (with 54 of 57 days beating CAMS), and the rolling-origin backtest shows an MAE of 5.5 at 72 hours.

cases.question: Is tomorrow morning okay for a run outside?
cases.answer:
Tomorrow morning (Sat 31 Oct 06:00) the forecast is Unhealthy with a predicted PM2.5 of 59.25 (80% range 39.78 to 81.25) and an AQI of 154. Health guidance for Unhealthy: everyone may begin to experience health effects; members of sensitive groups may experience more serious health effects. 

Live track record shows an overall MAE of 6.849 with 54 of 57 days beating CAMS, and backtest MAE at 24 hours is 4.698 with 85.3% 80% range coverage.

cases.question: How sure is the forecast for 48 hours from now?
cases.answer: For the 48-hour lead time, the live track record shows an MAE of 7.0 (with a skill of 41.9% vs CAMS), while the backtest accuracy at 48 hours has an MAE of 5.254 (R² of 0.597) with an 80% range coverage of 84.6%.

cases.question: How accurate has this forecast actually been?
cases.answer: The live track record shows an overall mean absolute error (MAE) of 6.8 against OpenAQ ground measurements, beating CAMS in 54 of 57 evaluated days with an overall skill score of 42.2% over CAMS. In the rolling-origin backtests, the model achieved a mean skill score of 47.0% over CAMS, with MAE ranging from 2.4 at 1 hour ahead to 5.5 at 72 hours ahead.

cases.question: Is this better than the Copernicus CAMS forecast?
cases.answer: Yes, this forecast outperforms the Copernicus CAMS forecast overall. Across all scored lead times, its overall MAE is 6.849 compared to CAMS's 11.847, yielding an overall skill score of 42.2% against CAMS. It has also beaten CAMS in 54 of 57 days.

cases.question: What is the backtested error at 72 hours?
cases.answer: At 72 hours, the backtested mean absolute error (MAE) is 5.5, with an R² of 0.5 and an 80% range coverage of 86.4%.

cases.question: How good is the 1-hour forecast?
cases.answer: In live tracking for the 1-6 hour bucket, the MAE is 5.5 (with a skill score of 0.538 vs CAMS and 0.331 vs persistence). In the backtest at the 1-hour lead time specifically, the MAE is 2.377 with an R2 of 0.907, an 80% range coverage of 84.9%, and a skill of 0.718 vs CAMS.

cases.question: What drives the forecast the most?
cases.answer: The 24-hour forecast is driven most by "Measured minus CAMS (now)" with a mean absolute SHAP value of 7.57, followed by "CAMS forecast for target hour" (4.02) and "Forecast wind speed" (3.02).

cases.question: Why does the model use CAMS as an input if CAMS is wrong?
cases.answer: Even though raw CAMS data can be inaccurate, our live track record shows the model successfully beats CAMS in 54 of 57 days, achieving an overall skill score of 0.422 against it. The backtest confirms this, showing a mean skill vs CAMS of 0.47 by using CAMS as one of many raw signals and correcting its errors.

cases.answer: Aaj raat Karachi mein hawa ki quality "Unhealthy" (AQI 177) rahegi, jahan PM2.5 ka predicted level 92.7 µg/m³ hai aur iska 80% range (p10 se p90) 72.0 se 134.0 µg/m³ ke darmiyan hai.

cases.question: Ye forecast kitna sahi hota hai?
cases.answer: Live track record ke mutabiq, yeh forecast published hone ke baad ground monitors ke mukabale mein overall 6.849 MAE aur CAMS se 42.2% behtar skill rakhta hai (aur 57 mein se 54 din CAMS ko beat kiya hai). Backtest accuracy mein bhi iska rolling-origin mean skill vs CAMS 47.0% hai, aur 80% range coverage live track mein 77.3% (aur backtest ke har lead time par kareeb 83.6% se 86.4%) raha hai.
